title: Voice and Speech AI: What Matters Now
excerpt: A closer look at Voice and Speech AI and the assumptions shaping the current debate.
content:
The story behind Voice and Speech AI is more complicated than it first appears. Different groups are interpreting the same development in very different ways.

Several forces are influencing this situation, including economic conditions, changing expectations and decisions made by companies and consumers.
